build.beforeDevCommand: cargo build -p acp-bridge && node scripts/stage-acp-bridge.mjs --debug && npm run dev
build.beforeBuildCommand: cargo build -p acp-bridge --release && node scripts/stage-acp-bridge.mjs && npm run build

security.csp: default-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost; img-src 'self' data: blob: asset: http://asset.localhost; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' 'unsafe-eval'; font-src 'self' data:; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'; frame-src asset: http://asset.localhost

bundle.shortDescription: Local-first AI data analysis desktop tool
bundle.longDescription: Local-first AI data analysis desktop tool. Analyze CSV, Excel and Parquet files locally with DuckDB; no data leaves your machine.
